description:
Full Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zDAE9A_1NA4

What if you try to sandwich a cube between two portals?
Does the cube disappear?
Do the portals bounce or stop?
Or something else?
Imagine instead that you extend a piston through the blue portal.
Eventually it comes back and hits itself from behind.
The piston can't keep extending into the portal because there is no "inside" of the portal - "inside" the blue portal is "outside" the orange portal, and vice versa.
At this point one of three things could happen.
If the piston is weak it should crumple, the same as if it were pushing against a solid wall.
If the piston is rigid and the portals are super heavy, then the piston will just stop expanding (since it can't lengthen any more without the portals moving farther apart).
